subject: Q3 feature launch — resource triage and rollout lanes
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sara Miller <sara@orionhealth.com>, Brian Holt <brian@orionhealth.com>
Date: 2026-05-27T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Q3 feature launch — resource triage and rollout lanes

Team,

Quick sync to align on launch lanes and where we need to make tradeoffs. Orion committed to a customer pilot that starts mid-July, so we have two main constraints: backend throughput for the new prefix-cache feature and enablement content readiness.

High-level asks (can each owner reply inline by EOD?):
- Product: confirm final scope for the July pilot vs. deferred items.
- Eng: confirm whether we can meet the July throughput targets for cohort A or if we need to split the feature across lanes.
- Enablement: list the minimal required artifacts for customer-facing docs and a train-the-trainer session.

Proposed rollout lanes (for discussion):
1) Lane A (canary): core model + prefix-cache (internal beta -> Orion pilot) — mid-July
2) Lane B (broad): full feature set (including analytics hooks) — late-August
3) Lane C (deferred): non-critical UX polish and extended telemetry — September/October

Attachments: launch_timeline_v1.xlsx (timeline draft), enablement_packet_draft.md (high-level outline).

Objective for replies: owners + single-line risk and suggested mitigation. I will consolidate and send the leadership readout tomorrow.

Thanks,
Diego
Diego Fernandez
Group Product Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sara Miller <sara@orionhealth.com>
Date: 2026-05-27T11:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Q3 feature launch — resource triage and rollout lanes

Diego — thanks for the clear asks. Quick updates inline: 

- Product scope: recommend we split the rollout. For July pilot (Lane A) we should ship the core model + prefix-cache but disable analytics hooks and the low-priority UX polish. Those can move to Lane B and C. Rationale: analytics adds 2–3 sprint backend work and risks pilot stability.

- Risk: If Eng cannot deliver the prefix-cache performance at scale, the pilot experience will degrade. Mitigation: offer a reduced token quota for Orion pilot users and enable tight sampling (limit sequence length).

Owners:
- Lane A owner: lauren_bishop (PM)
- Eng lead for core: rishi_malhotra
- Enablement lead: marissa_cole

Attachment: forwarding the small excerpt from the API capacity runbook for visibility.

On postponement: I'm asking the backend team for a feasibility note by EOD tomorrow. If they push back, propose a one-week shift to the pilot start and use that week for an isolated load test with Orion traffic shape.

—Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Director, Product Management, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Sara Miller <sara@orionhealth.com>, Brian Holt <brian@orionhealth.com>
Date: 2026-05-27T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Q3 feature launch — resource triage and rollout lanes

Thanks — from Enablement perspective: we can support Lane A for a pilot in mid-July provided we focus materials on three artifacts: 

Required artifacts for pilot (minimum viable enablement):
- One-pager: "Pilot scope & limitations" (customer-facing) — owner: marissa_cole
- Runbook: "On-call steps for pilot issues" (internal) — owner: grace_oconnor
- Training: 90-min train-the-trainer session + slide deck + recording — owner: marissa_cole

Gaps I see now:
- No finalized API changelog for the prefix-cache toggles (blocks docs examples)
- No sample dataset slices that mimic Orion's request distribution (blocks runbook run-through)

Mitigations / timeline: 
- We can produce the one-pager and training deck by Jun 30 if Eng provides the API toggle semantics by Jun 9.
- I'll schedule two 60-min lab sessions with Orion success team during the pilot week (mid-July) if the timeline holds.

Attachments: enablement_packet_draft.md (outline + owners).

Ask to Eng/Product: confirm by Jun 9 whether the prefix-cache toggle API will be stable and provide a short spec (fields, defaults, error cases). If that goes late, we need to (a) push pilot 1 week, or (b) run pilot with feature-flagged fallback and extra on-call coverage.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Manager, Customer Enablement, Redwood Inference
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sara Miller <sara@orionhealth.com>, Brian Holt <brian@orionhealth.com>
Date: 2026-05-28T14:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Q3 feature launch — resource triage and rollout lanes

Appreciate the quick turn. Summary and next steps: 

- We will adopt the split lanes (A/B/C) as described.
- Eng (Rishi): please provide the API toggle spec by Jun 9 and a go/no-go call for prefix-cache performance by Jun 10. If no, signal and we shift pilot to Jul 21.
- Enablement (Marissa): target deliverables by Jun 30; confirm train-the-trainer slots and a recording plan.
- Lauren: publish the updated scope doc in the shared drive and tag owners by EOD Jun 1.

I'll draft the slide for the leadership readout and include the contingency (one-week delay) as an explicit exception path. If anyone sees a missing item, reply here with a one-line add.

Diego
Diego Fernandez
Group Product Manager, Redwood Inference
Attachments: launch_timeline_v1.xlsx (updated), enablement_packet_draft.md (updated)
